001: Shota, I heard you recently started a new social media app. Is that true?
Yeah, I started an app that's focused on photos. Yuki, do you want to try it too?
Sounds nice. But I'm a bit worried because I don't really know how to use it.
It's fine. To start, you just need to find people to follow.
I see. So, can I follow you, Shota?
002: The other day, I found an interesting community on an internet forum.
Oh, what kind of topics does the forum cover?
It's a place where people talk about foreign movies, and the information is really detailed.
That's great. I like movies too, so can you tell me about it later?
Yeah, sure. I'll send you the link.
Thanks. I'm looking forward to it.
003: Sakura, have you ever actually met someone you got to know on social media?
No, not yet. I'm worried about safety, after all.
That's true. Meeting people you met online does come with risks.
Right. So I only stick to exchanging photos and messages.
That's a smart decision. I'll be careful too.
004: Recently, I joined an online cooking class community.
Oh, a cooking community. What do you do there?
Every weekend, we all make the same recipe and share photos with each other.
That sounds fun. It also seems like a good way to improve your cooking.
Exactly. Plus, there are people from all kinds of regions, so the conversations are interesting.
Nice. I'm starting to get interested too.
005: Daisuke, how do you take the photos you post on social media?
I don't do anything particularly difficult. I just take them in natural light, I guess.
I see. But your photos look really stylish, Daisuke.
Thanks. Also, keeping the background simple makes it look better.
I see, the background. I'll try that next time.
Yeah, I'm sure you'll take great shots.
006: Hey, the other day I got a weird message from someone I met online.
What? What did it say? Are you okay?
It asked me to share my personal information. It creeped me out, so I blocked them right away.
That was the right call. You should never give your contact info to people like that.
Yeah, I know. But it kind of scared me.
That's understandable. If anything happens, talk to me right away, okay?
007: Kenta, are you part of an online gaming community?
Yeah, I am. We get together a few nights a week and play.
Oh, so you have gaming buddies. What kind of games do you play?
Mostly cooperative action games. It's fun progressing through the game while calling out to each other.
That sounds like it requires teamwork.
It does. That's why I think we naturally become close friends.
008: Recently, I tried making a recipe I found on social media, and it was really delicious.
Oh, that's great. What kind of recipe was it?
It's an easy Japanese-style pasta recipe, and it only needs a few ingredients.
That's convenient. If you don't mind, could you share the recipe with me?
Of course! I'll send you the link later.
Thanks. I'll try making it this weekend.
009: Misaki, you post about your hobbies on social media a lot, don't you?
Yeah, I love reading, so I write about my thoughts on the books I've read.
Seeing that made me want to read the same book too.
Really? That makes me happy. If you'd like, tell me your thoughts after you read it.
Of course! I'll get in touch with you then.
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
010: Lately, I feel like I'm wasting time by using social media too much.
Ah, I know what you mean. Sometimes I catch myself scrolling for hours without realizing it.
Have you done anything to deal with it?
Yeah, I decided on a set amount of time and I set a timer.
I see. Setting a time limit is a good method. I'll try that too.
Yeah, let's both find a good balance with it.
